WITH polypeptides AS (
  SELECT 'enzymes' AS src, id, name, amino_acid_sequence, parent_id
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides"
  UNION ALL

  UNION ALL

SELECT

WITH cyp_inhibited AS (
  SELECT
    e.name,
    e.inhibition_strength,
    e.position
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes" e
  WHERE e.parent_key = :drugbank_id
    AND LOWER(e.name) LIKE 'cytochrome p450 %'
    AND e.inhibition_strength IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(LOWER(e.inhibition_strength)) NOT IN ('', 'unknown')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    name,
    inhibition_strength,
    position,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY position) AS inhibited_rank
  FROM cyp_inhibited

SELECT
  name AS cyp_enzyme,
  inhibition_strength,
  position AS enzyme_position,
  inhibited_rank AS rank_among_inhibited_cyp
FROM ranked
WHERE LOWER(inhibition_strength) LIKE '%weak%'
ORDER BY enzyme_position
LIMIT 50;

WITH oct_salts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    dl.parent_key,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(dl.title) LIKE '%pamoate%' THEN 'Octreotide pamoate'
      WHEN lower(dl.title) LIKE '%acetate%' THEN 'Octreotide acetate'
    END AS salt_form
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  WHERE lower(dl.title) LIKE '%octreotide%'
    AND (lower(dl.title) LIKE '%pamoate%' OR lower(dl.title) LIKE '%acetate%')
),
mass_props AS (
  SELECT
    ep.parent_key,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(ep.value, ' ') > 0 THEN CAST(REPLACE(substr(ep.value, 1, instr(ep.value, ' ') - 1), ',', '') AS FLOAT)
      ELSE CAST(REPLACE(ep.value, ',', '') AS FLOAT)
    END AS mass_val
  FROM "drugbank_drug_experimental_properties" ep
  WHERE lower(ep.kind) LIKE '%average mass%' OR lower(ep.kind) LIKE '%molecular weight%'
)
SELECT
  os.salt_form AS salt_form,
  AVG(mp.mass_val) AS average_mass
FROM oct_salts os
JOIN mass_props mp ON mp.parent_key = os.parent_key
GROUP BY os.salt_form
ORDER BY average_mass DESC
LIMIT 1;

  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"

top_two AS (
  SELECT ref_id
  FROM candidate_refs
  WHERE num_parents >= 2
  ORDER BY ref_id
  LIMIT 2

GROUP BY d.ref_id, d.parent_key

  SELECT
    parent_key,
    name,
    inhibition_strength,
    position
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes"

    AND organism = 'Humans'

ranked AS (

    parent_key,
    name,
    inhibition_strength,
    position,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_key ORDER BY position, name) AS inhibited_cyp_order
  FROM cyp_inhibited
)

  parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  name AS cyp_enzyme,
  inhibition_strength,
  inhibited_cyp_order AS order_among_inhibited_cyps,
  position
FROM ranked
WHERE lower(inhibition_strength) LIKE 'weak%'
ORDER BY inhibited_cyp_order
LIMIT 50;

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

WITH us_pediatric AS (
  SELECT number, expires
  FROM "drugbank_drug_patents"
  WHERE country = 'United States'
    AND (pediatric_extension = 1 OR pediatric_extension = 'True' OR pediatric_extension = 'true')
)
SELECT
  expires AS common_expiration_date,
  GROUP_CONCAT(number, ', ') AS us_patent_numbers_with_pediatric_extension,
  COUNT(*) AS patent_count
FROM us_pediatric
GROUP BY expires
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY expires
LIMIT 50;

sql_executed:
WITH cp AS (
  SELECT
    c.parent_key AS drug_id,
    LOWER(cp.name) AS lname,
    cp.amino_acid_sequence AS seq,
    LOWER(cp.amino_acid_sequence) AS lseq,
    cp.amino_acid_format AS fmt
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" cp
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers" c ON c.id = cp.parent_id
  WHERE cp.amino_acid_format = 'FASTA'
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT
    drug_id,
    CASE
      WHEN lname LIKE '%antibody heavy chain%' OR lseq LIKE '%antibody heavy chain%' OR (lname LIKE '%heavy chain%' OR lseq LIKE '%heavy chain%') THEN 'heavy'
      WHEN lname LIKE '%antibody light chain%' OR lseq LIKE '%antibody light chain%' OR (lname LIKE '%light chain%' OR lseq LIKE '%light chain%') THEN 'light'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS chain_type,
    seq
  FROM cp
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT drug_id, chain_type, seq
  FROM tagged
  WHERE chain_type IN ('heavy','light')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    drug_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN chain_type = 'heavy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heavy_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN chain_type = 'light' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS light_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT seq) AS distinct_seq_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY drug_id
  HAVING heavy_count > 0 AND light_count > 0 AND distinct_seq_count >= 2
)
SELECT
  a.drug_id,
  MIN(CASE WHEN s.language = 'english' THEN s.synonym END) AS drug_name
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" s ON s.drugbank_id = a.drug_id
GROUP BY a.drug_id
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  e.name AS enzyme_name,
  e.inhibition_strength,
  e.position,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) + 1
    FROM "drugbank_enzymes" e2
    WHERE e2.parent_key = e.parent_key
      AND e2.position < e.position
      AND e2.inhibition_strength IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(e2.inhibition_strength) NOT IN ('unknown', 'n/a', 'none', '')
  ) AS relative_order_among_inhibited
FROM "drugbank_enzymes" e
WHERE e.parent_key = :drug_id
  AND LOWER(e.name) LIKE 'cytochrome p450 %'
  AND e.inhibition_strength IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(e.inhibition_strength) LIKE 'weak%'
ORDER BY e.position
LIMIT 50;

WITH candidate_links AS (
  SELECT title, ref_id, url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%grapefruit%'

SELECT

  CASE

      substr(
        substr(url, instr(url, 'pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/') + length('pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/')),
        1,
        CASE instr(substr(url, instr(url, 'pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/') + length('pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/')), '/')

          ELSE instr(substr(url, instr(url, 'pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/') + length('pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/')), '/') - 1
        END
      )
    WHEN url LIKE '%ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/%' THEN
      substr(
        substr(url, instr(url, 'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/') + length('ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/')),
        1,
        CASE instr(substr(url, instr(url, 'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/') + length('ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/')), '/')
          WHEN 0 THEN length(substr(url, instr(url, 'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/') + length('ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/')))
          ELSE instr(substr(url, instr(url, 'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/') + length('ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/')), '/') - 1
        END
      )
    ELSE ref_id
  END AS pubmed_id
FROM candidate_links
LIMIT 50;

sql_executed:
WITH combined AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(action) AS action, parent_id FROM "drugbank_targets_actions"
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(action) AS action, parent_id FROM "drugbank_carriers_actions"
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(action) AS action, parent_id FROM "drugbank_enzymes_actions"
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(action) AS action, parent_id FROM "drugbank_transporters_actions"
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    parent_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'inhibitor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_inhibitor,
    SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'binder' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_binder,
    SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'substrate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_substrate
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY parent_id
)
SELECT parent_id
FROM agg
WHERE has_inhibitor > 0
  AND has_binder > 0
  AND has_substrate > 0
ORDER BY parent_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH relevant AS (

    p.number,
    p.expires
  FROM "drugbank_drug_patents" p
  WHERE p.country = 'United States'

FROM relevant r
CROSS JOIN common c
ORDER BY r.expires, r.number
LIMIT 50;

WITH polypeptides AS (
  SELECT name, amino_acid_sequence, amino_acid_format, parent_id
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, amino_acid_sequence, amino_acid_format, parent_id
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides"
),
cetux AS (
  SELECT
    parent_id,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(name) LIKE '%heavy chain%' OR lower(amino_acid_sequence) LIKE '%heavy chain%' THEN 'heavy'
      WHEN lower(name) LIKE '%light chain%' OR lower(amino_acid_sequence) LIKE '%light chain%' THEN 'light'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS chain_type
  FROM polypeptides
  WHERE amino_acid_format = 'FASTA'
    AND (lower(name) LIKE '%cetuximab%' OR lower(amino_acid_sequence) LIKE '%cetuximab%')
)
SELECT parent_id AS record_identifier
FROM cetux
WHERE chain_type IN ('heavy', 'light')
GROUP BY parent_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN chain_type = 'heavy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

sql_executed:
WITH pk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key AS drug_id, url AS packager_url
  FROM "drugbank_drug_packagers"
  WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%oso biopharmaceuticals manufacturing%'
),
rx_names AS (
  SELECT drug_id, group_concat(DISTINCT drug_name) AS drug_name
  FROM (
    SELECT left_drugbank_id AS drug_id, left_drugbank_name AS drug_name
    FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
    UNION
    SELECT right_drugbank_id AS drug_id, right_drugbank_name AS drug_name
    FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  )
  GROUP BY drug_id
),
link_names AS (
  SELECT parent_key AS drug_id, MIN(title) AS drug_title
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  GROUP BY parent_key
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(rx_names.drug_name, link_names.drug_title, pk.drug_id) AS medication,
  pk.packager_url AS packager_url
FROM pk
LEFT JOIN rx_names ON rx_names.drug_id = pk.drug_id
LEFT JOIN link_names ON link_names.drug_id = pk.drug_id
LIMIT 50;

SELECT DISTINCT
  a.citation,
  a.pubmed_id
FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_articles" AS a
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_carriers" AS c
  ON c.id = a.parent_key
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" AS p
  ON p.parent_id = c.id
WHERE
  (
    (c.name IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%vitamin d-binding protein%')
    OR (p.name IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(p.name) LIKE '%vitamin d-binding protein%')
    OR (p.gene_name IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(p.gene_name) = 'gc')
    OR LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%vitamin d-binding protein%'
    OR LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%dbp%'
  )
  AND LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%affinity%'
  AND LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%vitamin d%'
  AND (LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%isoform%' OR LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%genetic%')
LIMIT 50;

  WHERE lower(a.level_2) = 'other diagnostic agents'
    AND s.language LIKE 'english%'

FROM (
  SELECT
    candidates.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY drugbank_id, atc_code ORDER BY pref, medication) AS rn
  FROM candidates
)
WHERE rn = 1
LIMIT 50;

WITH poly AS (
  SELECT parent_id, 'alpha-2A' AS subtype, name
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides"
  WHERE amino_acid_format = 'FASTA'
    AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%alpha-2a%' OR LOWER(amino_acid_sequence) LIKE '%alpha-2a%')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_id, 'alpha-2B' AS subtype, name
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides"
  WHERE amino_acid_format = 'FASTA'
    AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%alpha-2b%' OR LOWER(amino_acid_sequence) LIKE '%alpha-2b%')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_id, 'alpha-2C' AS subtype, name
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides"
  WHERE amino_acid_format = 'FASTA'
    AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%alpha-2c%' OR LOWER(amino_acid_sequence) LIKE '%alpha-2c%')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_id, 'alpha-2A' AS subtype, name
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides"
  WHERE amino_acid_format = 'FASTA'
    AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%alpha-2a%' OR LOWER(amino_acid_sequence) LIKE '%alpha-2a%')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_id, 'alpha-2B' AS subtype, name
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides"
  WHERE amino_acid_format = 'FASTA'
    AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%alpha-2b%' OR LOWER(amino_acid_sequence) LIKE '%alpha-2b%')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_id, 'alpha-2C' AS subtype, name
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides"
  WHERE amino_acid_format = 'FASTA'
    AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%alpha-2c%' OR LOWER(amino_acid_sequence) LIKE '%alpha-2c%')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    parent_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subtype) AS subtype_count,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT subtype) AS subtypes
  FROM poly
  GROUP BY parent_id
  HAVING subtype_count = 3
)
SELECT parent_id, subtypes
FROM agg
LIMIT 50;

WITH matches AS (
  SELECT
    t.parent_key,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha-2a%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha 2a%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha2a%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha(2a%' THEN 'A'
      WHEN LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha-2b%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha 2b%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha2b%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha(2b%' THEN 'B'
      WHEN LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha-2c%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha 2c%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha2c%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha(2c%' THEN 'C'
    END AS subtype,
    t.name AS target_name
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  WHERE
    LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha-2a%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha 2a%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha2a%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha(2a%'
    OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha-2b%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha 2b%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha2b%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha(2b%'
    OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha-2c%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha 2c%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha2c%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%alpha(2c%'
)
SELECT
  m.parent_key,
  group_concat(DISTINCT m.target_name) AS matching_targets
FROM matches m
GROUP BY m.parent_key
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.subtype) = 3
LIMIT 50;
